title: EMUCOREX VS AetherSX2 ‼️MANA YANG PALING LANCAR
summary: GAME DODI places EmuCoreX directly beside AetherSX2 on lower-cost Snapdragon 685, MediaTek and Helio G99-class phones, making comparative smoothness under constrained hardware the subject rather than another installation walkthrough.

blocks.text: The short Indonesian comparison names two ad-free Android PS2 options—AetherSX2 and EmuCoreX—and frames the test around modest phone hardware. Snapdragon 685, a Dimensity platform and MediaTek Helio G99 are called out in the description. That scope gives the entry a distinct purpose: it is not another tour of menus, but a prompt to inspect how two emulator paths behave when CPU and GPU headroom are limited. The result is most useful when the same game scene and settings are visibly repeated across both apps.

Exact Dimensity variant, phone models, games, renderers, resolutions and coverage of every listed chipset remain unspecified. Frame-time captures and correctness checks are also unavailable. The title's question about which emulator is smoother therefore remains local to whatever runs are shown, not a general ranking across all three hardware families. A fair replication must hold the device, game revision, scene, thermal state and graphics settings constant before comparing pacing in practice.
